goal: 在 E 维度新建首个 Theme E.1「跨文化设计交流与展示」与 E.1.1／E.1.2 两个 Topic，把 1851 年万国博览会、1915 年巴拿马赛会、1793 年马葛尔尼使华、2010 年上海世博会，以及 1985–2007 年间的国际展览、评奖与专业会议共 11 个 KU 集中挂载。
unresolved: 1851 Great Exhibition: Zhao Nong gives only two summary passages; host city, hall dimensions, exhibitor count, exhibit list and visitor numbers are missing, and Chinese participation is not recorded

Panama-Pacific Exposition: name, opening date, duration, twelve halls and 300-plus participants are verifiable, but Chinese exhibit classification, judging criteria and award list are absent; Tian Zibing records only the Beijing lacquer award
Shanghai Expo 2010 KU holds only Zhao Nong's 2008 expectation; actual opening, theme, participants, pavilions and visitor data are not recorded, so it cannot stand as a record of what happened

Macartney embassy rests on one Zhao Nong passage; the 600 cases of industrial and scientific instruments, their whereabouts and the Qing court response are missing, and whether it constitutes a prehistory of expositions is not argued by the source
YSL 1985, Bauhaus 1989, computer art 1995, China-Italy 1999 and CAD 2000 records give only name, date and place; organizers, exhibits or agendas, audiences and later effects are missing
1997 China Art Exhibition has organizer and symposium information, but exhibition scale, work list and report contents are missing

Hannover Industrial Design Forum is bound only to the phrase 'Germany's oldest industrial design institution' and the 2007 iF design award china; founding year, organizational nature, judging system and historical data are absent, and the source does not equate it with iF International Forum Design GmbH
No mediating evidence links 'entering an international exhibition or winning an award' to 'a change in design ideas'; the Theme does not treat participation or awards as proof of a modernity shift
Chinoiserie, foreign-style architecture, qipao and other cross-cultural entries remain unmounted; dimension E does not close because E.1 exists
2401 KUs remain unmounted; E.1 covers only 11 KUs
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Theme（E.1）与 2 个 Topic（E.1.1、E.1.2），挂载 11 个 KU：1851 年万国博览会、1915 年巴拿马赛会、2010 年上海世博会以 evidence_event 挂入 E.1.1，1793 年马葛尔尼使华以 historical_context 挂入 E.1.1；包豪斯 1989 年香港展、伊夫·圣·洛朗 1985 年回顾展、1995 年计算机艺术研讨会、1997 年中国当代艺术设计展、1999 年中国—意大利工业设计周、2000 年 CAD 国际会议以 evidence_event 挂入 E.1.2，汉诺威工业设计论坛以 key_institution 挂入 E.1.2。E.1 按“博览会展示—国际评奖—专业会议”三渠道分层，区分“被展示”“被评价”与“主动引入”三种位置；马葛尔尼使华只作展示体系前史，2010 年上海世博会保留 2008 年预期表述的证据边界，包豪斯与伊夫·圣·洛朗等条目只具事件性证据强度。未新增 KU、claim、candidate 或来源字节，未改写 03基础书籍-md文档/ 与 02-sources/，未执行 commit 或 push。
